text: oh and for the grouping of outliners, you could pass a duplicate to that same idea here would be great.
resolution: Added a Duplicate control to organizational group rows. It copies every member through the existing host-native part operation, preserves paint and editable part boundaries, assigns the copies a fresh collision-free numbered group, and focuses the complete copied group immediately. Hidden or unstamped groups fail before copying to avoid predictable partial folders. Added focused naming coverage; type-check and ReleaseFast ship pass.
